title: The out-of-the-box Service Manager role cannot open Credit Terms
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on the out-of-the-box "Service Manager" role, reset to its template.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-32 User.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Credit Terms" does not show (the role does not have Settings, Finance).
  • Step 2: New Customer shows the "Credit Terms" and "Credit Limit" fields (the role has View and Manage AP/AR Data).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Out of the box, Move Customers is therefore available to Admin, Parts Manager and Office User; Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor and Sales Representative hold 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' but not 'Settings → Finance', so they cannot open the Credit Terms page.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “By default 'Settings → Finance' is on for the Admin profile (required, cannot be turned off), Parts Manager and Office User, and off for Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Technician, Sales Representative and Time Clock User.”
  • S5-R1: “New Customer shows a "Credit Terms" dropdown and a "Credit Limit" field side by side, in the same place they sit on Edit Customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "5 New Customer", "6 Customer on a deactivated term" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
